We also provide a post-incident report (technical summary, root cause, mitigations) and a communications template we can share.

Alex / Jordan — thanks for looping me in. Quick details from the security side and what we can supply this week: 

1) Incident response (IR) & breach notification
- Confirmation and triage: immediate upon detection.
- Notification: customers impacted by confirmed unauthorized access are notified within 72 hours of confirmation; for confirmed breaches affecting PII we follow a documented escalation path and will coordinate outreach with the customer’s security or legal team when required.
- Post-incident report: typically provided within 10 business days (initial technical summary) with a final write-up after RCA (30–60 days depending on complexity).

2) Evidence we can provide (redacted as needed)
- SOC 2 Type I report (if requested) and our SOC 2 control mapping spreadsheet (redacted).
- Incident Response playbook summary (IR_Playbook_Summary.docx).
- BCP/DR overview and latest tabletop exercise report (BCP_DR_Charts.xlsx).
- Audit log retention policy and sample log retention table (we keep detailed request logs for 12 months by default; longer retention available by request).

3) Transfer method
- We can prepare a secure SFTP drop with time-limited credentials and audit logs. Alternatively we can provide an expiring signed link to a secured document store (AWS S3 presigned link with 7-day expiry). Please confirm which your team prefers.

4) Regulatory notes
- GDPR: we support data subject access and have data processing addendum available.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA covered workflows via our Private deployment options; we can discuss controls that are relevant for your use case.

I’ll assemble the evidence bundle and provide the SFTP details (or links) once you confirm preference. Happy to run a 30m show-and-tell of the IR playbook for your security team.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.in
